structured.answer: A keren hishtalmut is savings from my salary: the employer adds up to 7.5% and I add 2.5%, and after 6 years I can take it all out without tax, but before that it's taxed and expensive. It sounds worth having because of the employer's part, but it isn't a guaranteed deposit, so I'll ask my son or the bank to help me pick the safest track and check the fees.
